notes: What computer-players needs from the player-strategy component (poker-strategy provides it). The observation is whatever the game's rules say one player may know (see game-rules.observation); moves are the game's own move values.

newMemory.returns: unknown (JSON-serialisable memory of how each opponent has played)

choose.returns: unknown|null (a move, or null when it has none; must not change memory)

observe.returns: unknown|undefined (the new memory; undefined when memory was changed in place)
